releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.104:
- SUB-TAB FOLDER CREATION MODAL: Clean on-screen dialog when tapping [+ ADD SUB-TAB] in Impossible Matrix.
- 1-TOUCH PRESETS: Instant suggestions for Liquors (Cognac, Tequila, Whiskey, Rum, Vodka), Beers, Wines, Food.
- TOUCH-FRIENDLY SUBCATEGORY PILLS: 1-touch folder assignment when editing products (e.g. assign Remy Martin directly to Cognac).
- AUTOMATIC FOLDER INHERITANCE: New products added while inside a sub-tab folder automatically inherit that sub-category.
- RG14 USB Scale live weight monitoring and tare in Alcohol Control.
- 100% Quality Standard: Verified with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
